items.reason: Update: an open workout saved by an older version reopens (older drafts load with missing parts as defaults, an edit left open by an older version is dropped, a one-exercise superset is tidied); settings saved by an older version keep their values and new switches take their defaults. Fresh install: no dots (see gap-7). Sideload vs Play: the watch install card sends members to a Play page that is only on test tracks (existing finding). Watch and phone on different versions: the phone asks the watch to open on every start with no version check; what an older watch app does with it could not be read here (watch code is another area); the known mismatch faults are existing findings. Panel cache after deploy does not apply to the phone app.

Gym membership ends: the gym's plan just says 'No longer sent' (existing finding); leaving the gym forgets trainer video links; the Gym tab's unread count is keyed to the current gym link. App not opened for months: plan weeks and easy weeks keep counting the away weeks, and the finish screen may blame sleep (existing findings); a workout left open for days is restored but Finish offers the real end time and an idle pause. Year end and leap day: feed and history dates are built from the day string, with the year shown when not this year. Trial and plan end, staff leaving and owner changing phone have nothing in these screens (no paid gate here).

New-member-only flows here: the 'Coming from Hevy or Strong?' card (welcome screen and empty Home) and the routine steps after an import. The watch start card shows on any member's next start, not only new installs. Badges are worked out from all past workouts, so existing members get them too.
Existing members reach the import from Settings, and the Hevy branch offers the routine link; an earlier importer can run the import again to get the routine steps.
Rule applied: every new-member flow in this area has a path for existing members; no finding.

The only 'new' mark in this area is the dot on a tab. A brand-new install (no older version remembered) starts with every current feature marked seen, so it shows no dots; an updater gets dots for features added since.
Rule applied: no new mark on things not new to a fresh install; the Badges row shows the newest earned badges, not a 'new' mark. No finding.
